text: In March 2021, Council adopted MM30.25 and requested staff to report to April 2021 Executive Committee on the feasibility of deferring development charges in the amount of $624,243.36 for the Anishnawbe Health Centre at 425 Cherry Street (Anishnawabe Health). In April 2021, City Council adopted staff report CC31.4, “Development Charges Deferral for Anishnawbe Health Toronto at 425 Cherry Street East'' and authorized staff City staff to enter an agreement in a form satisfactory to the City Solicitor to defer the payment of development charges for Anishnawbe Health in accordance with general terms and conditions set out in the report. Staff were directed to review the matter as part of the development charges bylaw review that is currently underway.
